metadata.title: Dual medial axes in finite-dimensional normed spaces
metadata.abstract: We study medial axes of nonempty closed sets in finite-dimensional real normed spaces whose norms are $C^1$ away from the origin. Using the differential of the norm, we define the dual $k$-medial axis by requiring the contact covectors associated with nearest points to have affine dimension at least $k-1$. In dimension $n$, we prove that this set is $(n-k+1)$-rectifiable for every $1\le k\le n+1$, and hence has Hausdorff dimension at most $n-k+1$. We give a direct geometric proof and characterize the dual medial axes through the superdifferential of the squared distance function, obtaining an alternative proof from a theorem of Alberti, Ambrosio, and Cannarsa on singularities of semiconvex functions. Under the additional assumption of strict convexity, the ordinary and dual medial axes coincide for $k=2,3$, yielding the corresponding rectifiability results for ordinary medial axes. For $k=4$, however, the ordinary rectifiability conclusion can fail even for norms arbitrarily close to Euclidean: we construct norms on $\mathbb R^3$ with smooth positively curved unit spheres arbitrarily $C^\infty$-close to the Euclidean sphere, together with four-point sets whose ordinary $4$-medial axes contain nondegenerate line segments.

analysis.workSummary: 在有限维光滑范数空间中，以最近点的接触余向量定义对偶 k-中轴并研究可求长性。
techniques: 范数微分与接触余向量
几何可求长性与扰动构造
analysis.breakthrough: 证明对偶 k-中轴为 n−k+1 可求长；严格凸时普通与对偶中轴在 k=2,3 一致，而 k=4 可在任意接近欧氏的范数下出现反例。
analysis.limitations: 范数需在原点外 C¹；k=4 的普通中轴结论不能由对偶结论推出，反例甚至有光滑正曲率单位球面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 精确区分欧氏结论中可推广部分与高阶失效机制。
